precision_contract_options.name: PDF-visible values are authoritative
precision_contract_options.meaning: Acceptance compares extraction against what the PDF prints.
precision_contract_options.validates: Document fidelity for every field, including rounding.
precision_contract_options.cannot_validate: Generator intent and exact invoice arithmetic — printed values do not reproduce the invoice arithmetic on 15/21 lines.
precision_contract_options.effect_p12_impl_01: No change needed; all 117 field comparisons pass at the printed precision.
precision_contract_options.effect_p12_impl_02: Waste evidence comes from printed descriptions — unaffected.
precision_contract_options.effect_calculation: Emissions from printed numbers would differ from generator intent.
precision_contract_options.effect_evidence: Records displayed values only; generator intent is lost.
precision_contract_options.effect_corpus_regen: Would require the oracle to be re-derived from the render.
precision_contract_options.hidden_defect_risk: HIGH — with the true value removed from the oracle, a real column misread becomes undetectable.

precision_contract_options.name: Generator/oracle values authoritative for everything
precision_contract_options.meaning: Acceptance compares extraction against full-precision oracle values.
precision_contract_options.cannot_validate: Extraction correctness for the rendered document: 29/63 line fields can never pass because those digits are not in the PDF.
precision_contract_options.effect_p12_impl_01: Would report 29 line-field and 6 document-field false failures.
precision_contract_options.effect_p12_impl_02: Quantity/supplier evidence judged against invisible digits.
precision_contract_options.effect_calculation: Validates the generator, not the document.
precision_contract_options.effect_evidence: Provenance would claim values absent from the source.
precision_contract_options.effect_corpus_regen: All documents would have to be rendered at maximum precision.
precision_contract_options.hidden_defect_risk: LOW for arithmetic; it hides the rendering relationship.

precision_contract_options.name: Split: PDF-visible for extraction, generator precision as generation-level ground truth
precision_contract_options.cannot_validate: Nothing material; needs a mechanism (see E) to compare at the document's precision.
precision_contract_options.effect_p12_impl_01: Confirms the implementation: 117/117 field comparisons reconcile exactly at the document's own precision.
precision_contract_options.effect_p12_impl_02: Clean — printed descriptions/quantities for the document lane, generator precision retained as metadata.
precision_contract_options.effect_calculation: Document-lane tests use printed numbers; generator-lane tests use full precision, stated explicitly.
precision_contract_options.effect_evidence: Evidence carries printed value + display precision + generator value as separately labelled layers.
precision_contract_options.hidden_defect_risk: LOW — a misread differs from the *printed* value, so it still fails.

precision_contract_options.name: Explicit numeric tolerance
precision_contract_options.validates: Nothing specific; it is a mechanism, not a policy.
precision_contract_options.cannot_validate: Which layer is authoritative, or whether a difference is display rounding rather than a misread column.
precision_contract_options.effect_p12_impl_01: A tolerance covering the observed £80 deviation also covers 9.4% of a 297.0 net — far too wide.
precision_contract_options.effect_p12_impl_02: Propagates loose comparisons into waste/quantity evidence.
precision_contract_options.hidden_defect_risk: HIGH — measured deviations reach 28.0 on a 297.0 net (9.4%) and 80.0 on a 6256.0 net (1.28%).

precision_contract_options.name: Field-specific precision rules derived from the document
precision_contract_options.meaning: Each document declares the display precision its own columns exhibit; comparison is exact at that precision, per field family.
precision_contract_options.validates: Document fidelity precisely, field by field.
precision_contract_options.cannot_validate: Nothing; it is the mechanism that makes C executable.
precision_contract_options.effect_p12_impl_02: Provides a per-document precision context for evidence.
precision_contract_options.effect_calculation: Calculation tests declare which layer they use.
precision_contract_options.effect_evidence: Precision becomes recorded provenance, not an assumption.
precision_contract_options.hidden_defect_risk: LOW when derived from the document itself (observed uniform per document: 0/2/3/4 dp).

recommended_contract: C as the policy, implemented with E as the mechanism: the printed value is authoritative for extraction acceptance, compared exactly at the document's own display precision, while the generator/oracle retains full precision as generation- and calculation-level ground truth. A and B alone are rejected by the measured evidence; D alone is rejected because deviations reach 9.4%.
oracle_policy: tools/demo_lab/p12_canonical_manifest.json is NOT changed. Its numeric values remain authoritative for generator-level validation; for extraction acceptance they must be interpreted through each document's display precision. Conflicting fields (the numeric values of 002/004 and the sub-4dp rates of 001/003/005) are recorded as conflicts, not corrected.
corpus_policy: p12-canonical-demo-v1 remains FROZEN (hashes verified in this analysis). No document, manifest or provenance file was modified.

precision_rules.policy: Precision is a per-document display property (observed 0/2/3/4 dp). Quantity, rate, line net, subtotal, VAT and gross all share the document's precision, with integer quantities printed without decimals. A field-specific rule must be derived per document from the document itself.

future_v2_rationale: Not required for a correct contract, but advised for investor clarity: a v2 rendered uniformly at 4 dp with no truncated description fragments would remove the one genuine source ambiguity in v1 (document 002 prints 'Qty: 25.8 t...' inside its description while its Qty column prints 26). v1 must remain available for regression.
